{"consolidated_memory":"CACHE MISS STORM INCIDENTS IN build/bazel/BUILD.bazel

Recurring problem: cache miss storm in the build graph. Repro method (consistent across all): build twice with no source change. Signal (consistent across all): rebuild of targets that should have been cached. Stack: Starlark. Covering check in CI: remote cache hit rate check. Component: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel.

FOUR SEPARATE OCCASIONS:

1. [2026-01-20] INCIDENT: Missing Composite Index
   - Condition: triggered only for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
   - Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
   - Fix: added composite index and backfilled in batches
   - PR #1946, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1
   - Result: reclaimed 78 GB of blob storage

2. [2026-01-29] INCIDENT: Unwrapped Transaction Writes
   - Condition: triggered only for payloads above roughly 2 MB
   - Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
   - Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
   - PR #7557, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2
   - Result: flaky test improved from 86 failures per 100 runs to zero
   - Note: same corner of build/bazel/BUILD.bazel as earlier work; context carried over

3. [2026-04-04] INCIDENT: Naive Datetime Comparison
   - Condition: triggered only for clients pinned to the v1 SDK
   - Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware (timezone-aware) datetime
   - Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
   - PR #8930, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-3
   - Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 41 consecutive days

4. [2026-07-23] INCIDENT: Race in Lazy Initialization
   - Condition: triggered only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
   - Root cause: race condition in lazy initialisation
   - Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
   - PR #9172, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-4
   - Result: backlog cleared 80 minutes after the deploy
   - Note: same corner of build/bazel/BUILD.bazel as earlier work; context carried over"}
